title: Page 6
content_zh:
音乐会已经快要开始了，七点二十五分，前台灯光渐渐转暗，可以想见台下聚集着许许多多的听众，等待今晚的音乐飨宴。
他们很多或许是慕名而来，很多或许是对于音乐有着特别的爱好，为着各种理由，他们聚集在此，屏息以待。
可是今晚的主角却显得心慌，在后台某个角落里焦急等待，她不是为了即将要上台而心慌，学习音乐的她，从小到大不知道上了多少次台，她早已习惯那种感觉。
让她心慌的是──那个人，到现在都还没来……还没来……
“你不是说过，不管怎样、不管再忙，你都会来啊……”她苍白着脸等着，心里渐渐泛着痛楚，彷佛一根针扎在心里，其中还酝酿着一丝不安、一丝恐惧，种种负面的情绪几乎将她淹没。
“明慧，时间到啰！上台吧！”
她一愣，瞬间看向时钟，秒针正以飞快的速度向十二的位置奔去，七点半就要到了，可是他还没来……
这是第一次，她竟然不想上台……
“陈姊，能不能再等一下？”
对方一脸不可思议，看着眼前这个年轻女孩，“傻瓜，说这什么傻话？你也不是第一次参加演奏会了，预定的时间还能改吗？”
“可是……”
对方没给她太多机会辩解，帮她拿起小提琴与琴弓，塞进她手里，“明慧，沈明慧，听我说，不管你现在是在担心什么、烦恼什么，该做的事一定要做，这没得商量，这一点你应该很清楚，对吧？”
她一脸茫然，抱着琴，怀里的琴好重，她几乎要抱不动，全身发软，竟然一点力气也使不出来。
她知道自己不应该，陈姊说得没错，这不是她第一次开演奏会了，她很清楚自己的职责──那就是到台上展现自己最佳的琴艺，博得满堂喝采，任何属于自己个人的负面情绪，统统必须在此刻藏起来，等待表演结束再说。
可是她慌啊……
那个男人，她不是怪他不来，她知道他……很忙，他身分很特殊，她怕……怕他不是不愿意来，而是出了什么意外……
然而在七点三十分的这个时刻，在前台已经爆出热烈掌声，今晚准备与她搭档的管弦乐团已经就座的这个时刻，她没有临阵退缩的机会，她没有抽腿拒绝上台的权利。
“明慧，快上去吧！”
她努力站起来，深呼吸，告诉自己别自寻烦恼，要自己别再担心，一切都跟平常一样，认识这样一个男人，这样一个背对着阳光，在黑暗世界里讨生活的男人，这种恐惧，她永远无法摆脱。
好吧……上台吧……

她迈开步伐向前台走去，一走上舞台，灯光立刻聚焦在她身上，全场掌声如雷，她努力一笑，压下心中的恐惧，认命的伪装自己，让自己看起来很快乐、很兴奋。
她好假……她根本笑不出来……
这是她的音乐生涯中，已经不知道第几场的音乐会了，过去，她举办过独奏会，也跟管弦乐团一起合作，就跟今天一样。这些年下来，沈明慧这个年轻的女音乐家已经是家喻户晓的人物。
也因此，她与他真的愈隔愈远，那是一种就算她再想否认，也无法视而不见的距离。
今晚的演出是以贝多芬的D大调小提琴演奏曲作为开场，由沈明慧这位小提琴乐手与身后的管弦乐团搭配演出，呈现出动人而华丽的乐音，企图征服在场每一位听众。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
不过今晚，沈明慧吸引众人的不只是她的外貌与衣着，还包括她的琴艺。
长年在美国学习音乐，她年纪轻轻早已名闻乐坛，跟许多乐团合作过，更是知名爱乐乐团的首席小提琴手。
她让人感到悸动之处，在于乐音中呈现的生命力，她精湛的琴艺有时候反倒在其次。
尤其是今晚，现场所有人听着她的演奏，大气都不敢喘一下，乐音澎湃激昂时彷佛登山，低吟慢语时彷佛潜水，强烈的起伏让每个人都被这样的声音紧紧吸引。
今晚她将这种恐惧与忧心统统化入演奏中，用音乐表达出，更发泄出她心里的种种害怕与恐惧。
偶尔她会看到台下第一排那唯一空下来的位子，那是她为他保留的特别席，也可以说是贵宾座，但到现在，那个位子还是空下来的。
她不敢再看，怕自己再乱想，怕自己会因此分心，让自己的演奏出了乱子，她收回视线，专注在拉奏上。
管弦乐团的搭配妙不可言，每个人都听得如痴如醉，沈明慧果然名副其实，年轻貌美的小提琴家，前途不可限量。
不知道经过了多久，她将自己的全部心力都放进音乐中，再也不准自己分心，一段接着一段、一节接着一节，毫不停歇的演奏，将自己的所有情绪全部藉由音乐分享给所有人。
终于沈明慧放下了琴弓，现场爆出如雷掌声，她有点讶异，还不知道到底发生了什么事情。
这如雷的掌声，当然大部分是给她，她站在舞台上，是今晚最令人瞩目的焦点。可是她自己的心思再度飞离开这舞台，先是看了台下第一排观众席中那依然空着的位子，然后思绪一乱，继续胡思乱想着。
还好，接下来十五分钟的中场休息时间，沈明慧跟指挥握握手之后就先退场，来到舞台后，她根本听不进其它工作人员的赞美，也听不进她的经纪人陈姊的赞美与叮咛，坐在椅子上发着呆。
“小慧，太好了，等一下继续保持下去，今晚就结束了，就是这么简单，你有没有听到，到现在掌声都还没结束呢！”
看了她一眼，沈明慧突然想开口问，可是却又将话收住。如果让她的经纪人陈姊知道，她跟这样的男人在一起，陈姊会怎么说？

陈姊带着几个工作人员离去，要让沈明慧利用这短短的十五分钟好好休息。她一个人东张西望，思绪始终无法集中。
过了中场了，他还是没来。没来没关系，希望不要出什么事，为什么……为什么她的眼皮跳得这么快，到底发生了什么事？
拜托，不要出什么事……不要……
她一转头，无意间看见了一旁的电视，晚间新闻报导了一则警匪枪战，醒目的标题、惊悚的报导，搭配血腥的画面，想要吸引每个人的目光，当然包括她的。
可是沈明慧看着竟全身发抖，眼眶一热，她慢慢摇头，嘴里喃喃念着不可能。尤其是报导中出现的几个名字，更是令她无法置信！
她发抖，不能自已的全身发抖，一种近乎绝望的恐惧感，夹杂着冰冷的刺痛感，从四肢向她的身体窜来，她的手脚冰到发痛，她的心也跟着冷掉，只有眼眶是热的，只有流出的泪水是热的。
“明慧姊，还剩五分钟喔！”
一旁的人喊着，此刻的沈明慧根本听不到其它人说话，她抓起一旁的手机，按下快速拨号键，这组号码她几乎倒背如流。
“拜托，接电话……接电话……拜托……我求你接电话……”她嘴边喃喃念着，泪水边滑落。
可是电话没有接通──
“您拨的号码没有开机，为您转进语音信箱……”
于是沈明慧挂断再拨一次，她反复拨打着，始终得不到响应，再也无法从电话里听见那熟悉的好听声音。
她瘫在椅子上不断流着泪水，却哭不出声音来；她觉得天旋地转，觉得天地好像崩灭了，她眼前的世界一黑，根本什么都看不到。
content_en:
The concert was about to start. At 7:25, the lights at the front desk gradually dimmed. You can imagine that there were many listeners gathered under the stage, waiting for tonight's music feast.
Many of them may come because of the reputation, and many may have a special interest in music. For various reasons, they gather here and wait with bated breath.
But tonight's protagonist seemed flustered and was waiting anxiously in a corner backstage. She was not flustered because she was about to go on stage. She studied music and had been on stage countless times since she was a child. She was already used to that feeling.
What makes her flustered is that that person hasn't come yet... He hasn't come yet...
"Didn't you say that no matter what, no matter how busy you are, you will come..." She waited with a pale face, and pain gradually filled her heart, as if a needle had been stabbed in her heart. There was also a trace of uneasiness and a trace of fear, and all kinds of negative emotions almost overwhelmed her.
"Minghui, it's time! Come on stage!"
She was stunned and looked at the clock. The second hand was running towards the twelve position at a very fast speed. It was almost half past seven, but he hadn't come yet...
This is the first time that she doesn't want to go on stage...
"Sister Chen, can you wait a little longer?"
The other party looked in disbelief and looked at the young girl in front of him, "Fool, what are you talking about? This is not your first time attending a concert. Can the scheduled time be changed?"
"But..."
The other party didn't give her much chance to defend. He picked up the violin and bow for her and put them into her hands. "Minghui, Shen Minghui, listen to me. No matter what you are worried about or troubled about now, you must do what you need to do. This is not negotiable. You should be very clear about this, right?"
She looked confused and hugged Qin. Qin in her arms was so heavy that she could hardly hold it. Her whole body was so weak that she couldn't exert any strength at all.
She knew she shouldn't. Sister Chen was right. This was not her first concert. She knew her duty very well - to show off her best piano skills on stage and win applause from the audience. Any negative emotions that belonged to her must be hidden at this moment and wait until the performance was over.
But she was panicking...
That man, she didn't blame him for not coming, she knew that he was... very busy, and he had a very special status. She was afraid... that he was not unwilling to come, but that something unexpected had happened...
However, at this moment of seven-thirty, when there was already loud applause at the front desk, and at this moment when the orchestra that was going to partner her tonight was already seated, she had no chance to back down, and she had no right to twitch her legs and refuse to go on stage.
"Minghui, come up quickly!"
She tried to stand up, took a deep breath, and told herself not to look for trouble, to stop worrying, and to keep everything as usual. She would never be able to get rid of this fear of knowing such a man, such a man who turned his back to the sun and lived in a dark world.
Okay...come on stage...
She stepped forward and walked towards the stage. As soon as she stepped onto the stage, the lights immediately focused on her, and the audience burst into applause. She tried her best to smile, suppressed the fear in her heart, and pretended to be happy and excited.
She is so fake...she can't laugh at all...
This is an unknown number of concerts in her music career. In the past, she has held recitals and collaborated with orchestras, just like today. Over the years, Shen Minghui, a young female musician, has become a household name.
Because of this, she was getting farther and farther away from him. It was a distance that she couldn't ignore even if she wanted to deny it.
Tonight's performance opened with Beethoven's Violin Performance in D major. The violinist Shen Minghui performed with the orchestra behind him, presenting moving and gorgeous music, trying to conquer every audience present.
[The impure description in this paragraphThe writing has been deleted, I’m extremely sorry]
But tonight, Shen Minghui attracted everyone not only with her appearance and clothes, but also with her piano skills.
Having studied music in the United States for many years, she has already become famous in the music world at a young age. She has collaborated with many orchestras and is the concertmaster of a well-known Philharmonic Orchestra.
What makes people throb about her is the vitality present in the music, and her exquisite piano skills sometimes come second.
Especially tonight, everyone in the room didn't dare to take a breath while listening to her performance. When the music was surging and passionate, it felt like climbing a mountain, and when she was crooning, it felt like diving. The strong ups and downs made everyone tightly attracted to such a sound.
Tonight, she put all this fear and worry into her performance, expressed it through music, and vented all the fears and fears in her heart.
Occasionally she would see the only empty seat in the first row of the audience. It was a special seat she had reserved for him. It could also be said to be a VIP seat, but until now, that seat was still empty.
She didn't dare to look again, fearing that she would think too much, that she would be distracted and cause trouble in her performance. She withdrew her eyes and concentrated on playing.
The combination of the orchestra was wonderful, and everyone was mesmerized. Shen Minghui truly lived up to his reputation. He is a young and beautiful violinist with a bright future.
I don’t know how long it took, but she put all her energy into the music, no longer allowing herself to be distracted. She played section after section, section after section, without stopping, sharing all her emotions with everyone through music.
Finally, Shen Minghui put down her bow, and thunderous applause erupted from the scene. She was a little surprised and didn't know what happened.
Of course, most of this thunderous applause was given to her. She stood on the stage and was the most eye-catching focus tonight. But her own thoughts flew away from the stage again. First she looked at the still empty seats in the first row of the audience, then her thoughts became confused and she continued to think wildly.
Fortunately, during the intermission of the next fifteen minutes, Shen Minghui shook hands with the conductor and left the stage. After arriving on the stage, she could not listen to the praises of other staff members or the praises and instructions of her manager Sister Chen. She sat in a chair in a daze.
"Xiaohui, that's great. Keep it up in a moment and tonight will be over. It's that simple. Did you hear that the applause hasn't ended yet!"
After glancing at her, Shen Minghui suddenly wanted to ask, but held back her words. If her agent, Sister Chen, knew that she was with such a man, what would Sister Chen say?
Sister Chen left with several staff members, asking Shen Minghui to take advantage of these short fifteen minutes to have a good rest. She looked around alone, unable to concentrate her thoughts.
It's past midfield, but he still hasn't come. It doesn't matter if she didn't come. I hope nothing happens. Why...why did her eyelids jump so fast? What happened?
Please, don't let anything happen...don't...
She turned her head and accidentally saw the TV nearby. The evening news reported a shootout between police and robbers. The eye-catching title, the shocking report, and the bloody scenes wanted to attract everyone's attention, including hers.
But Shen Minghui was trembling all over and her eyes were hot. She slowly shook her head and murmured that it was impossible. Especially the names that appeared in the report made her unbelievable!
She was trembling, her whole body was shaking uncontrollably, a feeling of near-desperate fear, mixed with a cold stinging sensation, rushing from her limbs to her body. Her hands and feet were so cold that they ached, and her heart also became cold. Only her eyes were warm, and only the tears she shed were warm.
"Sister Minghui, there are five minutes left!"
People on the side were shouting. At this moment, Shen Minghui couldn't hear the other people talking at all. She grabbed the mobile phone beside her and pressed the speed dial button. She almost dialed this group of numbers.It's like running backwards.
"Please, answer the phone... answer the phone... please... I beg you to answer the phone..." She murmured as tears fell down her lips.
But the call didn't go through──
"The number you dialed is not turned on. It will be forwarded to your voicemail..."
So Shen Minghui hung up and dialed again. She dialed repeatedly, but never got a response. She could no longer hear the familiar pleasant voice on the phone.
She collapsed on the chair and kept crying, but she couldn't make a sound; she felt like the world was spinning and the world seemed to collapse. The world in front of her went black and she couldn't see anything at all.
